card.name: Words just before a study or trial
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as in, from, or observed that come right before a mention of a study, trial, or analysis. It appears in results and adverse-event passages.

modes.label: Linking word before study
modes.description: The word in or from sits just before a phrase like the clinical trial or this meta-analysis.
modes.example: Although acute systemic allergic reactions were not seen<< in>> clinical trials with BabyBIG, epine

modes.label: Observed before a trial context
modes.description: The word observed follows a finding and leads into a description of the study group.
modes.example: The adverse event profile<< observed>> in these patients was generally similar to that

card.writes: It promotes the word study, so the model expects study or trial to come next.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to say in the study or in the trial.
